subject.title: [Feature]: Thread replies when agent uses tools; top-level for conversational responses

question: Should Slack gain a new default-off tool-use-sensitive reply policy, and what precedence should it have relative to replyToMode, per-channel overrides, DMs, existing threads, and explicit top-level opt-outs?
rationale: The feature is source-confirmed absent, but adding a new config key and reply-routing heuristic changes compatibility-sensitive Slack channel behavior that source inspection cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Approve a precise Slack policy
options.body: Define the config shape and precedence, then allow a focused Slack plugin implementation with schema, docs, streaming, and regression tests.

options.title: Use static reply modes only
options.body: Treat per-channel/per-chat replyToMode as the supported solution and close this direction only after that maintainer decision is explicit.

options.title: Fold into broader reply policy
options.body: Defer this heuristic until multi-channel reply threading has a unified product contract.

recommendation.title: Approve a precise Slack policy
recommendation.body: Define the config shape and precedence, then allow a focused Slack plugin implementation with schema, docs, streaming, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and merged the closest recent Slack reply-mode work and is the strongest history-backed owner for the product-policy question.
